Warehouse API v3

Base endpoint: /api/warehouse

  • GET /api/warehouse/:resource/:id? — list or retrieve records.
  • POST /api/warehouse/:resource — create records.
  • PUT /api/warehouse/:resource/:id — update records.
  • DELETE /api/warehouse/:resource/:id — delete records.

Inventory balances are read-only. Use receipts, deliveries, transfers, or adjustments to change stock.
